what_it_does: Severe rain counts only if at least this many of the creek's rain gauges are at Very heavy or above (1 = no confirmation)
A rain gauge counts toward the rain level only if its newest reading is younger than this
Creek level trend (rising / steady / falling) is the fitted slope over this many minutes
A slope smaller than this either way counts as Steady
The rising-tide line shows when the next high tide is within this many hours
POLICY: whether severe rain or rising fast can make a creek without flood levels "Be ready" (1) or only "Stay alert" (0)
